title: Fix CSV rerun nested runtime paths
summary: Fix live CSV rerun so the nested pipeline uses operator-visible LocalBase state while staging inputs, library profile roots, and parked outputs in an isolated sibling rerun workspace.
reason: Live CSV rerun launched and staged rows, but the generated temp config put SourceMovies, SourceTV, and parked Outsource under LocalBase. After that path-shape issue was fixed, live validation showed LibraryProfiles still pointed at non-rerun source roots, causing the nested pipeline to find zero queue rows. Both failures left the app without useful normal pipeline, queue, or progress state for CSV rerun work.
behavior_before: Live CSV rerun staged media under LocalBase\RerunQueue and parked output under LocalBase\RerunParked\Output, then launched the nested pipeline with the original LocalBase. Config validation failed with LocalBase/SourceMovies, LocalBase/SourceTV, and LocalBase/Outsource nesting errors before queue/progress state was written; profile-enabled configs could also scan zero staged rows because LibraryProfiles still referenced the normal source/output roots.
behavior_after: Live CSV rerun keeps nested pipeline LocalBase on the configured operator-visible state root, stages rerun inputs and parked outputs under a LocalBase sibling workspace, rewrites movie/tv LibraryProfiles to staged roots with promotion disabled, creates the parked Output directory before launch, and records both paths in the rerun manifest/log evidence.
tests_added: Added ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-RerunNestedConfigChecks.ps1 to run a synthetic CSV rerun through nested pipeline startup with LibraryProfiles present, assert no LocalBase nesting errors, verify temp config path/profile separation, and confirm queue_snapshot.json includes staged rerun rows under the operator-visible LocalBase.

notes: This is a high-risk CSV rerun/pipeline pathing fix, but it does not weaken the global path-shape validator and does not enable source-mutating rerun modes.
